description: Gritting/Salting Routes FCC is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Fingal County Council. Location of Winter salting routes in Fingal. From October to April the Transportation Department undertakes salting of the major road network throughout the County in response to forecast weather conditions. The roads salted include Motorways, National Primaries, Regional Roads, Main Distributor Roads and main bus routes. Coverage: Fingal County Council. The portal files it under the publisher Fingal County Council. Its tags are Fingal County Council, Gritting, Open Data, Road Maintenance, Road Safety. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
